data.title: Pension insurance rejects application for full disability pension (volle Erwerbsminderungsrente)
data.summary: Rentenversicherung Beispiel-Nordwest rejected Johanna Beispielacker's application for a full disability pension, finding she can still work light duties at least six hours a day and is therefore not considered disabled under § 43 SGB VI. An objection (Widerspruch) can be filed by the deadline shown, which the app calculates from the date the decision is deemed delivered.
data.explanation: The pension insurer decided you are not entitled to a full disability pension because doctors found you can still work light jobs for six or more hours a day. If you disagree, you can file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the pension office; the app will show you the exact deadline, which runs for one month starting a few days after this letter's date (standard postal notification rule). Consider asking a lawyer or a social welfare association (Sozialverband) for help, as they can represent you for a modest membership fee. If you let the deadline pass without objecting, this rejection becomes final.
